<translated_code>
import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 15;
    static final int M = 100005;
    static final int INF = (int)1e9;
    static final int[] dx = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static final int[] dy = {1, -1, 0, 0};

    static char[][] c = new char[N][N];
    static char[][] S = new char[N][N];

    static int n, t;
    static int sx, sy, st, ed, tot;
    static int[] id = new int[N][N], dis = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] vis = new int[N][N];

    static int[] que = new int[M];
    static int[] fox = new int[N * N * 2 + 10]; // adjacency list
    static Edge[] s = new Edge[M * 2];
    static int k1 = 1;

    static class Edge {
        int ed, before, flow;
        public Edge(int ed, int before, int flow) {
            this.ed = ed;
            this.before = before;
            this.flow = flow;
        }
    }

    static class Node {
        int x, y;
        public Node(int x, int y) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
        }
    }

    static Node[] Q = new Node[M];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] parts = br.readLine().split(" ");
        n = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
        t = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            c[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            S[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        }

        for (sx = 0; sx < n; sx++) {
            for (sy = 0; sy < n; sy++) {
                if (c[sx][sy] == 'Z') break;
            }
            if (sy != n) break;
        }
        tot = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                id[i][j] = ++tot;
            }
        }

        st = 2 * tot + 1;
        ed = st + 1;

        initAdj();

        bfs();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (c[i][j] > '0' && c[i][j] <= '9') {
                    add(st, id[i][j], c[i][j] - '0');
                    find(i, j, id[i][j]);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (S[i][j] > '0' && S[i][j] <= '9') {
                    add(id[i][j] + tot, ed, S[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(maxFlow());
    }

    static class Edge {
        int ed, before, flow;
        public Edge(int ed, int before, int flow) {
            this.ed = ed;
            this.before = before;
            this.flow = flow;
        }
    }

    static void initAdj() {
        Arrays.fill(fox, 0);
        k1 = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i <= N * N * 2 + 10; i++) {
            fox[i] = 0;
        }
        Arrays.fill(s, null);
    }

    static void add(int p1, int p2, int p3) {
        s[++k1] = new Edge(p2, fox[p1], p3);
        fox[p1] = k1;
        s[++k1] = new Edge(p1, fox[p2], 0);
        fox[p2] = k1;
    }

    static boolean check(int x, int y) {
        if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= n || y >= n || vis[x][y] != 0 || c[x][y] < '0' || c[x][y] > '9') return false;
        return true;
    }

    static void bfs() {
        int l = 1, r = 0;
        int[] dist = new int[N][N];
        for (int[] row : dist) Arrays.fill(row, -1);
        Arrays.fill(vis, 0);

        dist[sx][sy] = 0;
        Q[++r] = new Node(sx, sy);
        vis[sx][sy] = 1;

        while (l <= r) {
            Node node = Q[l++];
            int ax = node.x, ay = node.y;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = ax + dx[i], ny = ay + dy[i];
                if (check(nx, ny)) {
                    dis[nx][ny] = dis[ax][ay] + 1;
                    vis[nx][ny] = 1;
                    Q[++r] = new Node(nx, ny);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void find(int tx, int ty, int idx) {
        int l = 1, r = 0;
        int[][] Dis = new int[N][N];
        for (int[] row : Dis) Arrays.fill(row, 60);
        int[][] v = new int[N][N];
        for (int[] row : v) Arrays.fill(row, 0);

        Queue<Node> queue = new LinkedList<>();
        Dis[tx][ty] = 0;
        v[tx][ty] = 1;
        queue.offer(new Node(tx, ty));

        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
            Node node = queue.poll();
            int ax = node.x, ay = node.y;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = ax + dx[i], ny = ay + dy[i];
                if (check(nx, ny)) {
                    if (Dis[nx][ny] > Dis[ax][ay] + 1) {
                        Dis[nx][ny] = Dis[ax][ay] + 1;
                        if (Dis[nx][ny] < dis[nx][ny]) {
                            v[nx][ny] = 1;
                            queue.offer(new Node(nx, ny));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Dis[i][j] <= t && S[i][j] > '0' && S[i][j] <= '9' && Dis[i][j] <= dis[i][j]) {
                    add(idx, id[i][j] + tot, INF);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int maxFlow() {
        int totalFlow = 0;
        while (bfsFlow()) {
            int flow;
            while ((flow = dfsFlow(st, INF)) != 0) {
                totalFlow += flow;
            }
        }
        return totalFlow;
    }

    static int[] distFlow = new int[M * 2];
    static int[] ptr = new int[M * 2];

    static boolean bfsFlow() {
        Arrays.fill(distFlow, -1);
        int l = 1, r = 0;
        int[] queue = new int[M];
        queue[++r] = st;
        distFlow[st] = 0;

        while (l <= r) {
            int p = queue[l++];
            for (int i = fox[p]; i != 0; i = s[i].before) {
                if (s[i].flow > 0 && distFlow[s[i].ed] == -1) {
                    distFlow[s[i].ed] = distFlow[p] + 1;
                    queue[++r] = s[i].ed;
                }
            }
        }
        return distFlow[ed] != -1;
    }

    static int dfsFlow(int p, int flow) {
        if (p == ed) return flow;
        int totalFlow = 0;
        for (int i = ptr[p]; i != 0; i = s[i].before) {
            if (s[i].flow > 0 && distFlow[s[i].ed] == distFlow[p] + 1) {
                int pushed = dfsFlow(s[i].ed, Math.min(s[i].flow, flow));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    s[i].flow -= pushed;
                    s[i ^ 1].flow += pushed;
                    flow -= pushed;
                    totalFlow += pushed;
                    if (flow == 0) break;
                }
            }
        }
        return totalFlow;
    }
}
